**WEBSITE DESIGN BRIEF  ·  FINAL**  
Christina Sookhoo  
Project Manager Portfolio Website  
Palette: Slate Grey · Beige · White · Eucalyptus Green  
**VISUAL CONCEPT**

**The idea: Calm authority**

The site should feel like the person it represents — organized, warm, confident, and a little unexpected. Not a corporate template, not a design agency portfolio. The palette is grounded and natural (slate, beige, eucalyptus) with enough visual contrast between sections to create rhythm and energy. The photo is a key design element — large and present, not a small headshot tucked in a corner.

 **COLOR PALETTE**

| Swatch | Name & Hex | CSS Variable | Usage |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
|    | **White** \#FFFFFF | \--color-white | Primary background · nav · hero left · cards |
|    | **Beige** \#F5F0E8 | \--color-beige | Section bg alternating · about · projects sections |
|    | **Light grey** \#F0F2F5 | \--color-light-grey | Experience section background |
|    | **Deep forest** \#2A3A30 | \--color-deep-forest | Hero photo panel · tools · contact · footer bg |
|    | **Slate grey** \#4A5568 | \--color-slate-grey | Dark pills · secondary emphasis |
|    | **Eucalyptus** \#5A8A6A | \--color-eucalyptus | ALL accent use — eyebrows, underlines, card tops, CTAs, bullets |
|    | **Ink** \#1A2028 | \--color-ink | All body text · headings · logo |
|    | **Stone** \#5A6570 | \--color-stone | Secondary / muted text |
|    | **Linen** \#DDE4DC | \--color-linen | Borders · dividers · card borders |

*Eucalyptus (\#5A8A6A) is the ONLY accent color. Use it for: section eyebrows, CTA underlines, bullet dashes, card top borders, numbered labels, and link hover states. Never as a section background fill. Deep forest (\#2A3A30) is used only for the hero photo panel, tools section, contact section, and footer backgrounds.*

**Section background rhythm**

The page alternates backgrounds to create visual rhythm. Follow this sequence exactly:

* Nav: White (\#FFFFFF)  
* Hero left panel: White (\#FFFFFF)  
* Hero right panel (photo): Deep forest (\#2A3A30)  
* About section: Beige (\#F5F0E8)  
* How I work section: White (\#FFFFFF)  
* Experience section: Light grey (\#F0F2F5)  
* Projects section: Beige (\#F5F0E8)  
* Brands strip: Beige/tan (\#F5F0E8) with slightly darker border  
* Tools section: Deep forest (\#2A3A30)  
* Contact section: Deep forest (\#2A3A30)  
* Footer: Deep forest (\#2A3A30)

**TYPOGRAPHY**

| Role | Font | Weights | Usage |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Display / headlines | Fraunces | 300 (light), 400 (regular), italic 300 | Name, section titles, pullquotes, case study titles, stat numbers |
| UI / body | Plus Jakarta Sans | 300, 400, 500, 600 | All body copy, nav, labels, eyebrows, pills, buttons, bullets |
| Logo / accent labels | Syne | 600, 700 | Nav logo, numbered labels (01 02 03), case study result numbers |

**CSS variables — full set**

:root {

  \--color-white:        \#FFFFFF;

  \--color-beige:        \#F5F0E8;

  \--color-light-grey:   \#F0F2F5;

  \--color-forest:       \#2A3A30;  /\* dark panel bg \*/

  \--color-slate:        \#4A5568;  /\* dark pills, secondary \*/

  \--color-eucalyptus:   \#5A8A6A;  /\* accent — all uses \*/

  \--color-eucalyptus-light: \#EAF0E8;  /\* light green pills \*/

  \--color-ink:          \#1A2028;  /\* all text \*/

  \--color-stone:        \#5A6570;  /\* muted text \*/

  \--color-linen:        \#DDE4DC;  /\* borders \*/

  \--font-display:       'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;

  \--font-body:          'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;

  \--font-accent:        'Syne', sans-serif;

  \--max-width:          900px;

  \--section-pad:        54px 44px;

}

**LAYOUT & SITE STRUCTURE**

**Hero layout** 

* Two-column grid: left text column (flex: 1\) \+ right photo column (320px fixed width)  
* Left panel background: White. Right panel background: Deep forest (\#2A3A30)  
* Photo fills the entire right panel — full height, object-fit: cover, object-position: center 8%  
* Stats overlay: absolute positioned at bottom of photo panel, gradient fade from transparent to deep forest  
* Stats display in a horizontal strip: 8+ / $15M+ / $2M / 3-yr — each in its own cell with a subtle right border  
* Hero name uses Fraunces at \~56px. The last name 'Sookhoo' is italic and slightly darker green (\#2A3A30)

**Page section structure**

| \# | Section | Background | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Hero | White \+ Deep forest panel | Two-column. Photo right, text left. Stats overlay on photo. |
| 02 | About | Beige \#F5F0E8 | Body text \+ pullquote with eucalyptus left border. |
| 03 | How I work | White | 3-column grid of 6 numbered competency cards. Border-top on each card. |
| 04 | Experience | Light grey \#F0F2F5 | Timeline layout: date column (130px) \+ content column. |
| 05 | Projects | Beige \#F5F0E8 | 3-column case study cards. Dark forest top border, green result strip. |
| 06 | Brands | Beige/tan strip | Centered brand names in two rows. Subtle top/bottom borders. |
| 07 | Tools | Deep forest \#2A3A30 | 4-column tool groups. Light text on dark bg. Green section labels. |
| 08 | Contact | Deep forest \#2A3A30 | Continues from tools. Light text. Green CTA underlines. |
| 09 | Footer | Deep forest \#2A3A30 | Very subtle. Name left, location right. Low-opacity text. |

 **CASE STUDY CARDS**

**Card structure**

* White card background, 1px border in \--color-linen (\#DDE4DC), 4px border-radius  
* Top accent border: 3px solid deep forest (\#2A3A30) — not eucalyptus  
* Card body: tag (eucalyptus, spaced caps) \+ Fraunces title \+ Plus Jakarta Sans body text  
* Result strip at bottom: background \--color-eucalyptus-light (\#EAF0E8), Syne font for the number, green text

**The three case studies**

* Client rescue — $2M incremental revenue following year  
* Process redesign — −20% delivery time · 20% revenue growth yr 1  
* Executive stakes — 3-year exclusivity agreement · multi-million renewal
